review.summary: The manifest generator, receiver, host checks, harness and documentation match the task and ADR-013, and the receive ordering, symlink-safe copy and staged-copy verification are sound. One finding: build-release accepts any self-consistent read-only folder, not only one accepted by shadow-receive.

findings.summary: build-release --source does not require the folder to be under the accepted sources directory, so it can build a folder that never passed the operator-digest check.
findings.rationale: The re-verification only checks the copy against the manifest inside that same folder; it never compares the manifest digest with an operator-approved value or checks where the folder is. A local test showed that a hand-made read-only folder named after a commit, with its own matching manifest, passes --verify. The upload account controls its upload folder and can make it read-only, so passing an upload path (by operator error or a later H3 wrapper) would build unapproved source. ADR-013 says build-release builds only from a verified folder under /opt/apps/shadow-sources.
findings.recommendation: In build-release, after load_config, require the resolved source folder's parent to equal the resolved SHADOW_SOURCES_DIR (and refuse otherwise), and add a harness case that an upload-style read-only folder outside the sources directory is refused before copying.
